description_en: Queries the monitoring information about queries within a time range
description_zh: 用于获取用户选定时间范围内查询的执行开始时间信息和结束时间信息
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-diagnosis-monitor-performance --db-cluster-id am-bp108q1py5r780000 --start-time 1671684348000 --end-time 1671687948000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --query-condition Type_:_maxCost_,_Value_:_100 --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDiagnosisMonitorPerformance

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the cluster IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
数仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查询目标地域中所有数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间。格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间。格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看指定数仓版支持的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The query conditions for SQL statements, which can be a combination of the `Type` and `Value` fields or a combination of the Type, `Min`, and `Max` fields. Specify the conditions in the JSON format. `Type` specifies the query dimension. Valid values for Type: `maxCost`, `status`, and `cost`. `Value`, `Min`, or `Max` specifies the query range for the dimension. Valid values:

`{"Type":"maxCost","Value":"100"}`: queries the top 100 most time-consuming SQL statements. Set `Value` to 100.
`{"Type":"status","Value":"finished"}`: queries the executed SQL statements, including successful and failed SQL statements. You can set `Value` to `running` to query the SQL statements that are being executed. You can also set Value to `failed` to query the SQL statements that failed to be executed.
`{"Type":"cost","Min":"10","Max":"200"}`: queries the SQL statements whose execution duration is in the range of 10 to 200 milliseconds. You can also specify custom values for the Min and Max fields
parameters.help_zh:
指定SQL的查询条件，格式为JSON字符串，包含`Type`、`Value`、`Min`或`Max`等字段。其中`Type` 表示查询维度（当前仅支持3个取值：`maxCost`、`status`和`cost`），`Value`、`Min`或`Max`表示该维度下的查询范围。具体支持的取值范围如下：
` {"Type":"maxCost","Value":"100"}`：表示查看执行耗时最长的前100条SQL详情，当前`Value`的取值仅支持设置为100。
`{"Type":"status","Value":"finished"}`：表示查看已完成的SQL详情（包含执行成功和失败的SQL）。您也可以将`Value`设置为`running`或`failed`来查询正在执行或执行失败的SQL详情。
`{"Type":"cost","Min":"10","Max":"200"}`：表示查看执行耗时为10毫秒~200毫秒的SQL详情，您也可以自定义执行耗时的最大值与最小值，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: query_condition

parameters.help_en:
The language of file titles and error messages. Valid values:

zh (default): simplified Chinese.
en: English.
ja: Japanese.
zh-tw: traditional Chinese
parameters.help_zh:
设置下载文件的文件标题以及部分错误信息的语言，支持如下语言：
zh：简体中文（默认语言）。
en：英文。
ja：日文。
zh-tw：繁体中文
parameters.name: lang

Performances.description_en: The monitoring information about queries displayed in Gantt charts
Performances.description_zh: 绘制甘特图的数据列表

Cost.description_en:
The total execution duration. Unit: milliseconds.

This value is the cumulative value of the `QueuedTime`, `TotalPlanningTime`, and `ExecutionTime` parameters
Cost.description_zh:
查询的总耗时。单位：毫秒。
该耗时指标是`QueuedTime`、`TotalPlanningTime`和`ExecutionTime`三个耗时指标的累加值

PeakMemory.description_en: The peak memory of the query. Unit: bytes

RcHost.description_en: The IP address of the AnalyticDB for MySQL frontend node on which the SQL statement is executed
RcHost.description_zh: 执行SQL语句的AnalyticDB MySQL前端节点IP

ScanSize.description_en: The amount of scanned data. Unit: bytes

StartTime.description_en: The execution start time of the SQL statement. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 目标SQL语句的执行开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒

Status.description_en:
The status of the SQL statement. Valid values:

running
finished
failed
Status.description_zh:
SQL语句的状态，取值为：
running：执行中。
finished：已完成。
failed：执行失败

UserName.description_en: The database account that is used to submit the query
UserName.description_zh: 提交查询使用的用户名

PerformancesThreshold.description_en:
The threshold for the number of queries displayed in a Gantt chart. Default value: 10000.

Up to 10,000 queries can be displayed in a Gantt chart even if more queries exist
PerformancesThreshold.description_zh:
绘制甘特图的查询条数阈值，默认为10000条。

即使实际的查询条数多于10000条，也只会使用10000条查询绘制甘特图

PerformancesTruncated.description_en:
Indicates whether all queries are returned. Valid values:

true
false
PerformancesTruncated.description_zh:
当前返回的查询是否为全部查询。返回值说明：

true：当前返回的查询条数是全部查询。
false：后台限制了返回条数，即当前返回的查询不是全部查询
